title: Your Groceries in a Flash: Understanding Quick Commerce and Blinkit's Big Push
description: Quick commerce delivers groceries and essentials super fast, often in 10-30 minutes. Companies like Blinkit use "dark stores" – small, online-only warehouses .

faq.a: A dark store is a retail outlet that is not open to walk-in customers. It functions as a mini-warehouse or fulfillment center, solely dedicated to processing and dispatching online orders quickly.

faq.q: How many dark stores does Blinkit have in India?
faq.a: As of July 2026, Blinkit operates 1,955 dark stores across India. The company plans to expand this to 3,000 stores by March 2027.

faq.q: Is quick commerce only available in big cities?
faq.a: While quick commerce started in metro cities, companies like Blinkit are actively expanding into Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities to reach a wider customer base.

faq.q: What kind of products can I order through quick commerce?
faq.a: You can typically order groceries, fresh produce, snacks, dairy products, personal care items, household essentials, and increasingly, even small electronics and other non-grocery items.

faq.q: How big is the quick commerce market in India?
faq.a: The quick commerce market in India is growing rapidly. It is estimated to be around USD 7.46 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach USD 134.10 billion by 2034. Another report estimates it to be ₹1.08 lakh crore in 2026.
